capabilities: crop images with an interactive dialog
view images in a fullscreen overlay
update the note's image reference to the cropped file
extras: Install is manual via release download; the Demo section contains no visible content. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in hover actions for images, so copying, cropping, or viewing an image full-size requires leaving the note or using menus.
summary: Floating image toolbar that shows copy, crop, and fullscreen actions when hovering over images in Live Preview and Reading view.
